motivation: Official coinmetrics/data main was rewritten to 65 commits beginning 2026-03-26. A historical Git object chain survives via croque-m/coinmetrics-data, a fork created 2024-12-08. Test original file columns and revisions at old commit SHA, never equate historical observation dates to publication dates.

sources.rights: Coin Metrics CC BY-NC 4.0; privately retain only summary, small samples and source hash; no bulk original CSV redistributions.

studyPlan: GET exact commit-pinned CSV byte streams; verify SHA1 Git blob with git blob header and any pinned lengths; reject mismatch
Audit per-snapshot historical columns, first/last included observation, row count, unique dates; distinguish old schema if needed
Extract anchor date values only if present; compare adjacent snapshots and 2026 retrospective MVRV on overlapping dates, reporting changed numeric cells and nulls separately
Do not claim earliest historical publication based on earliest OBSERVED among only these prespecified sample dates
Classify original Git commit timestamp as historical version evidence, not first-seen publication proof; fork created Dec 2024 does not independently timestamp earlier objects
Any unavailable raw source or Git integrity mismatch is a reportable negative and must not be silently replaced
archive: Research report + git SHA validated metadata and small fixed samples + R2 SHA256 upload/readback and workflow artifact, no raw CSV rehosting.
